entries.question: Shipping tracking and where to send bug reports?
entries.teaser: UPS shipping; team email; report bugs in General or Beta Support.
entries.answerHtml: Units ship via UPS. The team emails you; tracking can take a while. For bugs, post in General or your personal Beta Support group.

entries.question: Device just arrived — what next?
entries.teaser: Send your serial number (SN), wait for our firmware-push notification, then follow Checklist_revised.
entries.answerHtml:
Send your serial number (SN) so the team can prepare a firmware push.

Pause — wait until we notify you that the new firmware update has been pushed.

Then open Announcements and continue with Checklist_revised.pdf (plus QuickStart / Checklist as needed).

entries.question: Recording shows, but nothing returns — or stuck on firmware 1.0.68?
entries.teaser: Send your serial number (SN), then wait for our firmware-push notification before continuing the checklist.
entries.answerHtml:
Send your serial number (SN) to the team.

Pause — wait until we notify you that the new firmware update has been pushed to your unit.

Only after that notification, continue with the steps in Checklist_revised (Announcements).

If you are still on 1.0.68, the same path applies: share your SN and wait for our push notification.

entries.question: Which iOS app build should I use?
Calendar in app but not on device — or BT connected with no voice actions?
entries.teaser: Usually old firmware; only calendars listed in the app sync.
entries.answerHtml: Usually old firmware — install the latest. Then Google events for calendars listed in the app can show on device. Flip only connects calendars listed in the app for now; more types coming. Android / Fold calendar feedback is noted, no commitment yet.

entries.question: Why Chinese characters in the UI or AI output?
entries.teaser: Language bug fixed — report if it returns.
entries.answerHtml: This language bug was fixed. If it returns, send a screenshot in General or Beta Support.

entries.question: Can I leave recording on all day?
entries.teaser: Yes — only saves when someone speaks; auto-clears after sync.
entries.answerHtml: Yes — leave it on. It only keeps audio when someone is speaking. After sync to your phone, device storage clears automatically.

entries.question: Can I use Flip with other AIs via MCP under the NDA?
entries.teaser: MCP is part of beta — fine to try with other AIs.
entries.answerHtml: MCP is part of the beta; it is fine to try with other AIs.

entries.question: Where is beta data stored?
entries.answerHtml: Beta data is stored on AWS in the United States and handled to meet applicable US rules.

entries.question: General channel
entries.teaser: Shared questions, announcements, and group bug reports.
entries.answerHtml: Shared questions, announcements, and bug reports visible to the beta group.

entries.question: Personal Beta Support group
entries.teaser: Private thread for shipment, serial number (SN), and one-to-one issues.
entries.answerHtml: Your private thread for shipment, serial number (SN), and one-to-one issues.

entries.question: Docs and what to include when reporting
entries.teaser: Checklist docs in Announcements; include serial number (SN), versions, screenshot.
entries.answerHtml: Announcements has Checklist.pdf, QuickStartGuide.pdf, and Checklist_revised.pdf after firmware pushes. Reports help most with repro steps, serial number (SN), app + firmware versions, and a screenshot or short video.
